title: Mimi Kitten and the Rolling Yarn Ball

scenes.title: Mimi Kitten and the Rolling Yarn Ball
scenes.subtitle: A Kids Story  •  Honey Bunny Kidz

lines.text: Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Mimi Kitten and the Rolling Yarn Ball!
Once upon a time, in a little cottage with a red roof, lived a tiny kitten named Mimi.
Mimi had soft, fluffy fur, a curly orange tail, and a pink collar with a little gold bell.
Meow! Hello, friends! My name is Mimi.
Mimi's favorite toy was a round, pink yarn ball. She loved it very, very much.
Look at my yarn ball! It is soft and pink, and it rolls and rolls!
Mimi gave her yarn ball a little pat with her paw. Pat, pat!
Oh no! The yarn ball rolled away. It rolled down the little garden path. Roll, roll, roll!
Come back, yarn ball! Wait for me!
Mimi ran after it as fast as her little paws could go.
In the garden, Mimi met her friend, Honey Bunny.
Hello, Mimi! Why are you running?
Hello, Honey! My pink yarn ball rolled away. Can you help me find it?
Of course! Friends help friends. Let's look together!
They looked at a big green bush. It was full of pretty red roses.
I see something red! Is it your yarn ball?
No, those are red roses. My yarn ball is pink.
Can you see the red roses? Point to them!
Then, they looked up, up, up, at a very tall flower.
I see something yellow! Is it your yarn ball?
No, that is a yellow sunflower. My yarn ball is pink.
Can you see the yellow sunflower? Point to it!
Where can my yarn ball be?
Let's look by the pond!
By the blue pond sat Dotty the Duckling. And right next to Dotty was something round and pink!
My yarn ball! I found it!
Hello, Mimi! This pink ball rolled right to me. Is it yours?
Yes, it is mine! Thank you, Dotty.
You're welcome. It is so pretty. I have never played with a yarn ball before.
Mimi looked at her yarn ball. Then she looked at Dotty. Mimi had a kind idea.
Dotty, would you like to play with my yarn ball too? Let's all play together!
Oh, yes please! Thank you, Mimi!
Hooray! Sharing is caring!
So the three friends played a rolling game. Let's roll the yarn ball with them!
Roll to Honey!
Roll to Dotty!
Roll to Mimi!
They rolled it again, and again, and again. They giggled and laughed all afternoon.
Playing together is so much more fun than playing alone!
And Mimi was right. When we share our toys, everyone can have fun, and we make our friends happy too.
When the sun began to set, Mimi carried her yarn ball home.
Thank you for helping me, Honey. Today was the best day! Purr, purr.
See you tomorrow, Mimi!
Can you remember? What colors did Mimi see today? Red roses, a yellow sunflower, a blue pond, and a pink yarn ball!
The end. See you next time on Honey Bunny Kidz!
